d: Deep teal, shoulder-length hair with choppy layers and long bangs is partially covered by a white peaked cap. The eyes are a vivid crimson with a sharp, intense expression, set on a youthful face with an adolescent maturity. The build is slender, wearing a white sailor-style top with teal trim, a red necktie, and a matching white pleated skirt with teal stripes, complemented by a brown leather belt and a small brown hip pouch. Signature details include a silver metallic shoulder guard on the right, heavy silver and red armored boots, and large mechanical naval gun batteries attached to the back via dark metallic arms.
